description: This file defines a class for handling Microsoft SQL Server native database operations within the ADOdb PHP library, including methods for type conversion, SQL generation for schema modifications, and handling constraints.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssqlnative
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict to provide schema and data type handling specific to Microsoft SQL Server native (mssqlnative) within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Converts a database-specific type to a generic type code.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SQL data type for a given meta type.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to add columns to a table.

methods.name: defaultConstraintName
methods.description: Retrieves the default constraint name for a column.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter columns in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or dropping indexes.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size or type string for a column based on parameters.
